name: sylastra-agent-tree
description: Agent orchestration plugin for OpenCode - forked from oh-my-opencode-slim

scripts.build:plugin: bun build src/index.ts src/tui.ts --outdir dist --target node --format esm --external @ast-grep/napi --external @opencode-ai/plugin --external @opencode-ai/plugin/* --external @opencode-ai/sdk --external @opencode-ai/sdk/* --external @opentui/core --external @opentui/solid --external jsdom
scripts.build:cli: bun build src/cli/index.ts --outdir dist/cli --target node --format esm --external @ast-grep/napi --external @opencode-ai/plugin --external @opencode-ai/plugin/* --external @opencode-ai/sdk --external @opencode-ai/sdk/* --external jsdom
scripts.build: bun run build:plugin && bun run build:cli && bun run copy:divoom-assets && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly && bun run generate-schema
scripts.build:release: bun run build && bun run scripts/build-release-artifact.ts
scripts.verify:release: bun run build:release && bun run scripts/verify-release-artifact.ts
